question:
The [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36b8849796c580982055955a50fdc4f52255de37b9ab29394b617633165696a9.png] represents a set of calculations that are common across all the given equations. Identify the calculations involved and solve the fourth equation on the same basis: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27cd960c0374839d63874592727f6f7c324cd5073cf9536a2034f7f509d03580.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: **(1st number ÷ 2) × 2nd number + 1 = Number**

I. (4 ÷ 2) × 5 + 1 = 11

II. (4 ÷ 2) × 8 + 1 = 17

III. (2 ÷ 2) × 9 + 1 = 10

**IV. (6 ÷ 2) × 3 + 1 = 10** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/456ce85a672faa1cf60dd1b21a5ef59e9682e5680141c184dcf787b3bf94a782.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
